scope: Read-only containment redesign review; no production publication was run.

passingCoordinates.finding: allowed_root is mandatory, resolved strictly, and the resolved manifest must be inside it.
Relative buildRoot resolves from allowed_root; absolute buildRoot is accepted only after its resolved path remains within allowed_root.
Relative governed paths resolve from buildRoot and must remain inside both buildRoot and allowed_root.
An absolute governed path may sit outside buildRoot but inside the shared allowed_root, permitting dictionary-build and public/roster siblings under one explicit trust root.
Resolved parent traversal outside buildRoot, absolute paths outside allowed_root, a manifest outside allowed_root, buildRoot escape, and symlink resolution outside the trust root are rejected.
All prior review/product, staging, mixed-mode, rollback, graph-parity, roster-restoration, and receipt-write protections remained green.

hardFailures.detail: node.cwd is taken directly from the manifest and passed to the process runner without _path(). It is therefore the sole governed filesystem path observed that is not required to remain within allowed_root. An absolute outside cwd or relative process-dependent cwd bypasses the redesign even though script, terms, output, public, roster, stage, receipt, and source paths are contained.

requiredCorrection: Resolve node.cwd through self._path during validate(), return the validated nodeCwd in state, and pass state["nodeCwd"] to node_runner.
Add negative tests for absolute-outside and symlink-escaped node.cwd plus a positive absolute sibling node.cwd within allowed_root.

containmentTestsCompleted: maintenance manifest spanning the allowed build tree
completedTests.note: The suite completed before the turn interruption; it was not rerun.
